_comment: Every innerHTML write is flagged: the two dynamic writes (location.hash/search) and the static string alike. They share one message with the two markup sinks below, so the Issues section groups all five locations into a single numbered entry. The innerHTML = "" on line 8 is an empty clear and is exempt. The outerHTML write and the insertAdjacentHTML() call name different sinks, which each locus line states - so the reader sees which sink was hit without the entry splitting.
